title: Effects of Statin on Hepatocellular Carcinoma Recurrence After Liver Transplantation

sections.abstract: This study aims to investigate whether statin therapy can help prevent recurrence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in transplant recipients who had liver transplantation for HCC. Multiple logistic regression analysis will be performed to evaluate the association between statin therapy and the risk of HCC recurrence after LT.
